reports.title: Csquare Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance Summary
section: For the full year 2026, Csquare expects total revenues between $1.14 and $1.16 billion, Adjusted EBITDA between $490 and $500 million, recurring capital expenditures between $50 and $60 million, and non-recurring growth capital expenditures between $620 and $640 million.

Metric | Updated 2026 Outlook | Prior Outlook
Total Revenue | $1,140 – $1,160 million | $1,130 – $1,170 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $490 – $500 million | $460 – $480 million
Recurring Capital Expenditures | $50 - $60 million | $55 - $65 million
Growth Capital Expenditures | $620 - $640 million | $610 - $660 million
